Adding one implements smoothing. @ adds query-count-weighted log probabilities. Subtracting the largest log score keeps exponentials numerically manageable without changing the normalized result. argmax selects the higher score. The classifier is based only on these counts, not a trained language model.
explanation.zh: 行代表类别、列代表词。sum 配合 keepdims 为每行保留列形状的分母。加一实现平滑。@ 把按查询计数加权的对数概率相加。减去最大对数分数能保持指数计算稳定，而不改变归一化结果。argmax 选择较高分数。分类器只依赖这些计数，不是训练好的语言模型。

title.en: Build rules, then understand what combining them changes
title.zh: 建立规则，再理解组合规则会改变什么

story.en:
Tao records whether a small kite stays in the air. His inputs include wind speed and the angle of the string. A single straight rule misses an interaction: a useful angle depends on the wind. He draws a decision tree with one question at each fork.

The tree handles the small table well. A deeper version then memorizes unusual trials. Tao compares shallower trees and a forest of varied trees. He checks how the forest combines their probabilities. The combined prediction is less tied to one tree’s rule, but it still needs held-out trials. A clear branch is a useful model choice, not proof of cause.
story.zh:
陶记录小风筝能否持续飞行，输入包括风速和拉线角度。一条直线规则忽略了交互：合适的角度取决于风速。他画出决策树，每个分叉问一个问题。

这棵树能处理小表格，但更深的版本开始记住异常试验。陶比较浅树与由不同树组成的森林，并检查森林如何合并概率。组合结果不再过度依赖某一棵树，但仍需留出试验验证。清楚的分支是有用的建模选择，不是因果证明。

concept.en:
A decision tree asks a sequence of questions, such as “wind speed below 3?” Each answer selects a branch. A leaf is the final group and supplies a prediction. To choose a split, compare how mixed the labels are before and after it. Gini impurity is zero for a pure group and larger for a mixed group.

A forest combines many randomized trees. Here we average their positive-class probabilities. Varied trees can reduce sensitivity to one noisy sample. Boosting, in a later chapter, learns corrections in sequence instead of training a collection by the same logic.
concept.zh:
决策树连续提问，例如“风速是否小于 3？”每个回答决定走哪条分支。叶子是最终分组，并给出预测。选择分裂时，比较分裂前后标签混杂程度。纯分组的基尼不纯度为零，混杂分组更高。

森林组合多棵带随机性的树。这里平均它们的正类概率。不同的树可以降低对单个噪声样本的敏感度。后面学习的提升法依次学习修正，与森林的训练逻辑不同。

application.en: Fit a shallow tree first and inspect its conditions against the data. Tune depth and minimum leaf size within validation, then compare a forest or boosted trees using identical splits and metrics. Examine stability across reasonable training variations. For interpretation, distinguish a useful predictive split from a causal explanation. Record whether an ensemble combines class votes or probabilities, since these can yield different decisions.
application.zh: 先拟合浅树，并对照数据检查其条件。在验证过程中调整深度与最小叶节点样本数，然后使用相同划分和指标比较森林或提升树。检查在合理的训练变动下结果是否稳定。进行解释时，应区分有用的预测划分与因果解释。记录集成模型组合的是类别投票还是概率，因为两者可能产生不同决策。

practice.en: The linked scikit-learn decision-tree guide demonstrates classification and regression trees and explains depth-related overfitting. Its ensemble guide distinguishes randomized forests from boosting and specifies that its forest classifier averages class probabilities. Those details ground the kite comparison and the averaging calculation below. They also explain why describing every forest implementation as a majority vote can obscure the actual prediction rule being used.
practice.zh: 所链接的 scikit-learn 决策树指南演示了分类树与回归树，并解释与深度相关的过拟合。其集成指南区分了随机化森林与提升法，并说明其森林分类器对类别概率取平均。这些细节支持了风筝模型比较以及下面的平均计算，也解释了为什么把所有森林实现都描述为多数投票，可能掩盖实际使用的预测规则。

topics.formula:
G(p) = 2 p (1 − p)
ΔG = G(p) − (n_L / n) G(p_L) − (n_R / n) G(p_R)
p_forest = (1 / T) Σₜ₌₁ᵀ qₜ

symbols.en: p is the positive-class fraction in a parent node and G is its binary Gini impurity. n is the parent sample count; n_L and n_R count samples sent to the left and right children, so n = n_L + n_R. p_L and p_R are their positive fractions. ΔG is the impurity reduction from that split. T is the number of trees, t indexes a tree, and qₜ is that tree's predicted positive probability for the same input. Σ adds these probabilities; p_forest is their unweighted average.
symbols.zh: p 是父节点中正类所占的比例，G 是其二元基尼不纯度。n 是父节点样本数；n_L 和 n_R 分别是送往左、右子节点的样本数，因此 n = n_L + n_R。p_L 和 p_R 是两个子节点的正类比例。ΔG 是该划分带来的不纯度下降。T 是树的数量，t 指定一棵树，qₜ 是这棵树对同一输入预测的正类概率。Σ 把这些概率相加；p_forest 是它们的未加权平均值。

calculation.en: A parent node contains six successful flights and four unsuccessful ones, so p = 0.6 and G = 2 × 0.6 × 0.4 = 0.48. A proposed split sends four successes and one failure left, and two successes and three failures right. The child impurities are 0.32 and 0.48. Each child has five examples, so weighted impurity is 0.5 × 0.32 + 0.5 × 0.48 = 0.40. The reduction is 0.08, a local improvement rather than proof of better test performance. Separately, suppose three trees predict positive probabilities 0.2, 0.7, and 0.9 for a new flight. Their average is 1.8 / 3 = 0.6, producing a positive decision at threshold 0.5. This probability average is the stated ensemble rule.
calculation.zh: 父节点包含六次成功飞行与四次失败，因此 p = 0.6，G = 2 × 0.6 × 0.4 = 0.48。一个候选划分把四次成功和一次失败送到左侧，把两次成功和三次失败送到右侧。两个子节点的不纯度分别为 0.32 和 0.48。每个子节点都有五个样本，因此加权不纯度为 0.5 × 0.32 + 0.5 × 0.48 = 0.40。不纯度下降了 0.08，这是局部改进，并不能证明测试性能更好。另一个独立示例中，假设三棵树对一次新飞行预测的正类概率分别为 0.2、0.7、0.9。其平均值为 1.8 / 3 = 0.6，在阈值为 0.5 时作出正类决策。这里明确使用的集成规则就是概率平均。

limits.en: Greedy splits optimize local choices and need not produce a globally optimal tree. Forests can still fail when many trees share the same misleading signal. Large ensembles require more resources and are harder to inspect. Feature importance describes model behavior under particular assumptions; it does not establish that changing a feature will change the outcome.
limits.zh: 贪心划分优化的是局部选择，不一定得到全局最优的树。如果许多树共享同一种误导性信号，森林仍可能失败。大型集成模型需要更多资源，也更难检查。特征重要性描述的是特定假设下的模型行为，并不能证明改变某个特征就会改变结果。

takeaway.en: Trees turn interactions into explicit regions; ensembles can stabilize predictions, but every added layer of complexity still needs validation on the intended task.
takeaway.zh: 树模型把交互作用转化为明确区域；集成方法可以稳定预测，但每增加一层复杂度，都仍需针对预期任务进行验证。

meaning.en: A final tree region that supplies a prediction.
meaning.zh: 决策树中提供预测的最终区域。

meaning.en: A label-mixing score; for two classes it is 2p(1−p).
meaning.zh: 衡量标签混杂的分数；二分类时为 2p(1−p)。

meaning.en: A prediction made by combining several models.
meaning.zh: 组合多个模型得到预测。

question.en: Why weight child impurities by their sizes?
question.zh: 为什么按子节点大小加权不纯度？

answer.en: A child containing nine examples should contribute more than a child containing one. The weights make the score describe a randomly selected parent example.
answer.zh: 含九个样本的子节点应比只含一个样本的子节点贡献更大。加权后，分数对应从父节点随机选一个样本的情况。

question.en: How does the split gain become 0.08?
question.zh: 分裂增益如何得到 0.08？

answer.en: The parent has impurity 0.48. The children have weighted impurity 0.5×0.32+0.5×0.48=0.40. Subtract to get 0.08.

question.en: Can three similar trees all make the same error?
question.zh: 三棵相似的树会犯同样的错误吗？

answer.en: Yes. Averaging does not remove a misleading pattern that all trees learned. Data quality and independent validation still matter.
answer.zh: 会。平均无法消除所有树都学到的误导模式。数据质量与独立验证仍然重要。

body.en: Change the left child to five successes and zero failures. Its positive fraction is one, so Gini becomes zero. Check whether this split also leaves enough examples for reliable evaluation.
body.zh: 把左子节点改为五次成功、零次失败。正类比例为一，基尼值为零。还要检查分裂后是否有足够样本可靠评估。

body.en: Compare probabilities [0.49, 0.49, 0.99]. Their mean is about 0.657, above 0.5. A majority of thresholded labels would be negative. State which combination rule you use.
body.zh: 比较概率 [0.49,0.49,0.99]，平均约为 0.657，高于 0.5。但先阈值化再多数投票会得到负类。要说明使用哪种合并规则。

title.en: Score a split and average trees
title.zh: 计算分裂分数与树的平均

intro.en: Compute the local criterion without building a whole tree.
intro.zh: 计算局部分裂准则，不构建整棵树。

code_examples.code:
def gini(positive, total):
    p = positive / total
    return 2 * p * (1 - p)
parent = gini(6, 10)
children = 0.5 * gini(4, 5) + 0.5 * gini(2, 5)
probabilities = [0.2, 0.7, 0.9]
print(f'parent: {parent:.2f}; children: {children:.2f}')
print(f'gain: {parent - children:.2f}')
print(f'forest probability: {sum(probabilities) / len(probabilities):.2f}')

explanation.en: The function converts counts into a positive fraction, then computes binary Gini impurity. Equal child sizes give weights of 0.5. Subtracting child impurity measures the local gain. sum divided by len averages tree probabilities. The numbers demonstrate one candidate split and one ensemble rule; no tree search or forest training occurs.
explanation.zh: 函数先把计数转成正类比例，再计算二分类基尼不纯度。子节点一样大，因此权重均为 0.5。相减衡量局部增益。sum 除以 len 得到树概率的平均。数值只展示一个候选分裂与一种集成规则，没有进行树搜索或森林训练。

title.zh: 提升法：学习下一次修正

story.en:
Yun predicts the duration of simple robot tasks. A constant estimate misses short and long tasks in opposite directions. She draws the errors beneath the predictions. Then she fits a tiny tree to those remaining errors. Its job is to predict a correction, not the full duration.

Yun adds only part of the correction. The training loss drops. She repeats this idea carefully and watches validation error as well. More trees keep improving the training fit, but they need not improve new tasks. She now understands boosting as a sequence of focused repairs whose number and size must be chosen with evidence.
story.zh:
云预测简单机器人任务的时长。常数估计对短任务和长任务产生相反方向的误差。她把误差写在预测下方，再用小树拟合剩余误差。这棵树负责预测修正量，而不是完整时长。

云只加入一部分修正，训练损失下降了。她谨慎重复这个过程，同时观察验证误差。增加树可以继续改善训练拟合，却未必改善新任务。她理解了提升法：一连串有针对性的修正，其数量与幅度都要由证据决定。

concept.en:
An ensemble combines several models. In squared-error gradient boosting, start with a simple prediction and fit a small learner to residuals. Here residual means target minus current prediction. It is the negative of the earlier chapter’s prediction error, so adding it points toward the needed correction. Add a learning-rate-scaled version of that learner.

The next learner sees the remaining errors after the previous update. This differs from averaging independently randomized trees in a forest. Other losses use their negative gradients instead of this exact residual. Tree depth, step size, and round count control flexibility.
concept.zh:
集成组合多个模型。平方误差梯度提升先建立简单预测，再用小模型拟合残差。这里残差定义为目标减当前预测。它是前面章节预测误差的相反数，因此加上它会朝所需修正方向移动。将小模型输出乘学习率后加入预测。

下一模型处理前次更新后剩余的误差。这不同于森林对随机化树取平均。其他损失使用负梯度，而不一定是这里的残差。树深度、步长与轮数共同控制灵活性。

application.en: Boosted trees are a common option for numeric and categorical tables after appropriate preparation. Compare them with a linear baseline. Choose stopping rounds on validation data and retain the same split rules used for other models.
application.zh: 经过合适预处理后，提升树是数值与类别表格的常见选择。应与线性基线比较。通过验证数据选择停止轮数，并沿用其他模型相同的划分规则。

practice.en: The official ensemble guide explains gradient boosting and its connection to loss gradients. The code fits one fixed-split stump to residuals. It demonstrates one real correction step, not a complete boosting library.
practice.zh: 官方集成指南解释梯度提升及其与损失梯度的联系。代码把一个固定分裂树桩拟合到残差，展示一次实际修正，并不是完整提升库。

topics.formula:
rᵢ = yᵢ − F₀(xᵢ)
F₁(xᵢ) = F₀(xᵢ) + η h(xᵢ)

symbols.en: i indexes training rows. yᵢ is the target. F₀ is the current predictor and F₁ is the updated predictor. rᵢ is the needed correction. h is a small learner fitted to those corrections. η is the learning rate, here between zero and one.
symbols.zh: i 表示训练行，yᵢ 是目标。F₀ 是当前预测器，F₁ 是更新后预测器。rᵢ 是需要的修正量，h 是拟合这些修正的小模型，η 是学习率，这里取零到一之间。

calculation.en: Targets [1,1,3,3] have mean 2. Starting at 2 gives residuals [−1,−1,1,1] and MSE 1. A stump separating the first two rows from the last two predicts those residuals exactly. With η=0.5, predictions become [1.5,1.5,2.5,2.5]. All squared errors are 0.25, so the new MSE is 0.25.
calculation.zh: 目标 [1,1,3,3] 的均值为 2。从 2 开始，残差为 [−1,−1,1,1]，MSE 为 1。树桩把前两行与后两行分开，恰好预测这些残差。η=0.5 时，预测变为 [1.5,1.5,2.5,2.5]。所有平方误差为 0.25，因此新 MSE 为 0.25。

limits.en: Repeated corrections can chase noise. A small training loss does not choose the number of rounds for you. The fixed split here is unusually easy and does not measure performance on real task durations.
limits.zh: 重复修正可能追逐噪声。训练损失小不能替你选择轮数。这里的固定分裂特别简单，不能衡量真实任务时长的性能。

takeaway.en: Boosting asks the next learner to repair what the current prediction still misses.
takeaway.zh: 提升法让下一个模型修复当前预测仍遗漏的部分。

meaning.en: A small model trained to predict the remaining correction.
meaning.zh: 学习预测剩余修正量的小模型。

meaning.en: A decision tree with one split and two leaves.
meaning.zh: 只有一个分裂、两个叶子的决策树。

meaning.en: One addition of a new correction model.
meaning.zh: 增加一个新修正模型的一次操作。

question.en: Why does the correction use target minus prediction?
question.zh: 为什么修正使用目标减预测？

answer.en: If the prediction is too high, this difference is negative. Adding a negative correction lowers it. The sign matches the repair we need.
answer.zh: 预测过高时，该差为负。加上负修正会降低预测，符号与所需修复一致。

question.en: Where does MSE 0.25 come from?
question.zh: MSE 0.25 如何得到？

answer.en: Each prediction remains 0.5 away from its target. Squaring gives 0.25 for every row, so the average is also 0.25.
answer.zh: 每项预测距目标仍差 0.5。平方均为 0.25，因此平均也是 0.25。

question.en: Why not always use η=1?
question.zh: 为什么不总取 η=1？

answer.en: It fits this easy example in one step. On noisy data, full corrections can fit incidental patterns too quickly. Select the rate and round count with validation.
answer.zh: 这个简单例子会一步拟合好。但噪声数据中，完整修正可能过快拟合偶然模式。应通过验证选择学习率和轮数。

body.en: Use η=0.25. Predictions become [1.75,1.75,2.25,2.25], giving MSE 0.5625. The correction direction is unchanged, but progress per round is smaller.

Change the final target from 3 to 8. Recompute the mean and leaf corrections. Explain why one unusual measurement can influence a squared-error learner strongly before deciding whether it is valid data.
body.zh: 把最后目标从 3 改为 8，重新计算均值与叶子修正。先解释为何一个异常测量会强烈影响平方误差模型，再判断它是否有效数据。

intro.en: The split at x<2 is fixed so we can inspect both leaf means.
intro.zh: 固定以 x<2 分裂，便于检查两个叶子均值。

code_examples.code:
import numpy as np
x = np.array([0.,1.,2.,3.]); y = np.array([1.,1.,3.,3.])
prediction = np.full_like(y, y.mean())
residual = y - prediction
left = x < 2
correction = np.where(left, residual[left].mean(), residual[~left].mean())
updated = prediction + 0.5 * correction
print('residual:', residual.tolist())
print('updated:', updated.tolist())
print(f'MSE before: {np.mean((prediction-y)**2):.2f}')
print(f'MSE after: {np.mean((updated-y)**2):.2f}')
code_examples.output:
residual: [-1.0, -1.0, 1.0, 1.0]
updated: [1.5, 1.5, 2.5, 2.5]
MSE before: 1.00
MSE after: 0.25

explanation.en: full_like makes a constant starting prediction with one entry per target. The Boolean left mask defines two leaves. Each leaf uses the mean residual, which minimizes its squared residual error. where sends each row its leaf correction. Adding half the correction performs one boosting step. No split search, multiple rounds, or independent validation are included.
explanation.zh: full_like 为每个目标生成常数初始预测。布尔 left 掩码定义两个叶子。各叶子取残差均值，它能最小化叶内残差平方误差。where 为每行分配对应修正。加上一半修正即完成一次提升。代码不含分裂搜索、多轮训练或独立验证。

title.zh: 寻找结构，不凭空赋予标签

story.en:
Imani measures stones from a river walk. She records length, width, mass, and texture but has no rock-type labels. A clustering program returns three groups. She almost names them as three geological types. Then changing grams to kilograms changes the groups.

Imani realizes that distance depends on units. She chooses a stated scaling rule and inspects representative stones. She also tries PCA to view the strongest directions of variation. The compact plot helps her ask better questions. It does not create the missing labels. She keeps neutral group names and seeks outside evidence before making a geological claim.
story.zh:
伊玛尼测量河边捡到的石头，记录长、宽、质量和纹理，却没有岩石类型标签。聚类程序返回三组，她差点把它们命名为三种岩石。随后，她发现把克改为千克就改变了分组。

伊玛尼意识到距离依赖单位。她明确选择缩放规则，并检查各组代表石头。她还用 PCA 观察变化最大的方向。紧凑的图帮助她提出更好问题，却不会补出缺失的标签。她使用中性组名，在提出地质结论前寻找外部证据。

concept.en:
Clustering proposes groups without using target labels. K-means assigns points to nearby centers, then moves each center to its group mean. Its objective adds squared distances to centers. More groups can reduce that number without making the interpretation better.

PCA answers a different question: which directions show the most spread after centering? It projects points onto those directions. The covariance matrix summarizes how coordinates vary together. An eigenvector is a direction whose orientation that matrix preserves; its eigenvalue measures the variance along it. These are geometric descriptions, not discovered class labels.
concept.zh:
聚类不使用目标标签，提出候选分组。K-means 把点分给较近中心，再把中心移到组内均值。目标函数加总点到中心的平方距离。增加组数可以降低该数值，却不一定改善解释。

PCA 回答另一个问题：减去均值后，哪个方向的离散程度最大？它将点投影到这些方向。协方差矩阵概括坐标如何共同变化。特征向量是矩阵作用后保持方向的向量，特征值表示该方向上的方差。这些是几何描述，不是发现的类别标签。

application.en: Choose features and scaling according to the comparison you intend, and preserve the transformation for later observations. Inspect representative members of each cluster and compare several plausible cluster counts or initializations. For PCA, report retained variance and examine the component loadings. If the representation will feed a supervised model, fit it inside training folds. Use domain evidence to interpret groups rather than treating cluster identifiers as discovered truth.
application.zh: 根据希望进行的比较选择特征与缩放方式，并保留该转换以处理后续观测。检查各簇的代表性成员，比较几个合理的簇数或初始化方式。对于 PCA，应报告保留的方差，并检查主成分载荷。如果这种表示将输入监督模型，应在训练折内部拟合它。解释分组时使用领域证据，不要把簇编号当成已经发现的真相。

practice.en: The linked scikit-learn clustering guide describes the k-means objective and the shapes it handles poorly. The linked decomposition guide illustrates PCA with a lower-dimensional view of the Iris measurements and notes that PCA centers inputs without automatically scaling each feature. These official examples clarify the different jobs of grouping and projection. The river-stone story and rectangular dataset below are original illustrations of those distinctions.
practice.zh: 所链接的 scikit-learn 聚类指南描述了 K 均值目标，以及它不擅长处理的形状。所链接的分解指南用鸢尾花测量值的低维表示说明 PCA，并指出 PCA 会中心化输入，但不会自动逐特征缩放。这些官方示例澄清了分组与投影承担的不同任务。河边石头故事和下面的矩形数据集，都是说明这些区别的原创示例。

topics.formula:
J = Σᵢ₌₁ⁿ ‖xᵢ − μ_cᵢ‖²
S = (1 / n) Σᵢ₌₁ⁿ (xᵢ − x̄)(xᵢ − x̄)ᵀ
S vⱼ = λⱼ vⱼ
r₁ = λ₁ / Σⱼ₌₁ᵈ λⱼ

symbols.en: n counts observations and i selects one. xᵢ is a vector of d features; cᵢ identifies its cluster and μ_cᵢ is that cluster's centroid. The squared norm ‖·‖² sums squared coordinate differences, and J is total within-cluster squared distance. x̄ is the mean vector. S is the covariance matrix using divisor n here. Superscript T transposes a vector, making the product an outer product. vⱼ is principal direction j and λⱼ its variance, ordered largest first. Σ denotes summation. r₁ is the variance fraction retained by the first component, assuming positive total variance.
symbols.zh: n 是观测数量，i 指定其中一个观测。xᵢ 是含 d 个特征的向量；cᵢ 表示其所属簇，μ_cᵢ 是该簇的质心。平方范数 ‖·‖² 对各坐标差的平方求和，J 是簇内平方距离总和。x̄ 是均值向量。S 是此处以 n 为分母的协方差矩阵。上标 T 表示向量转置，使该乘积成为外积。vⱼ 是第 j 个主方向，λⱼ 是对应方差，按从大到小排列。Σ 表示求和。在总方差为正的前提下，r₁ 是第一主成分保留的方差比例。

calculation.en: Consider four two-dimensional points: (0,0), (0,2), (4,0), and (4,2), with both axes already in comparable units. Two clusters divided by the first coordinate have centroids (0,1) and (4,1). Every point has squared distance 1 from its centroid, so J = 4. A single centroid at (2,1) gives squared distance 5 per point and J = 20. For PCA, subtract the mean (2,1). The population covariance matrix is diagonal with entries 4 and 1, so the first principal direction is (1,0), up to its arbitrary sign. It preserves 4 / (4 + 1) = 80% of total variance. Keeping one component discards the vertical distinction. Lower clustering loss and high retained variance describe geometry, not the correctness of imagined category labels.
calculation.zh: 考虑四个二维点：(0,0)、(0,2)、(4,0)、(4,2)，两个坐标轴已经使用可比单位。按第一个坐标分为两个簇后，质心为 (0,1) 和 (4,1)。每个点到所属质心的平方距离都是 1，因此 J = 4。如果只使用位于 (2,1) 的单个质心，则每个点的平方距离都是 5，J = 20。进行 PCA 时，先减去均值 (2,1)。总体协方差矩阵为对角矩阵，对角元素为 4 和 1，因此第一主方向为 (1,0)，方向符号可以任意反转。它保留了 4 / (4 + 1) = 80% 的总方差。只保留一个主成分会舍弃竖直方向上的区别。更低的聚类损失与更高的保留方差描述的是几何性质，而不是想象出来的类别标签是否正确。

limits.en: K-means can struggle with irregular shapes, unequal densities, and outliers; its objective also decreases as more clusters are allowed. PCA captures linear variance, which may reflect nuisance variation instead of useful signal. Scaling choices alter both analyses, and a visually separated projection does not establish a meaningful scientific distinction.
limits.zh: K 均值可能难以处理不规则形状、不同密度和离群值；允许更多簇时，其目标值也会下降。PCA 捕捉线性方差，而方差可能来自干扰变化，并非有用信号。缩放选择会改变两种分析，投影图中看起来分离也不能证明存在有意义的科学区别。

takeaway.en: Use clustering to propose groups and PCA to compress variation, then test your interpretation with evidence that neither method supplied.
takeaway.zh: 用聚类提出分组，用 PCA 压缩变化，再用这两种方法本身没有提供的证据检验解释。

meaning.en: The coordinate-wise mean of the points assigned to a group.
meaning.zh: 一个分组内各坐标分别求平均得到的中心。

meaning.en: Coordinates obtained by measuring a point along selected directions.
meaning.zh: 沿选定方向测量一个点得到的坐标。

meaning.en: The share of total spread retained by selected PCA directions.
meaning.zh: 选定 PCA 方向保留的总离散程度比例。

question.en: Why is the two-cluster loss 4?
question.zh: 为什么两组的损失为 4？

answer.en: Each point is one vertical unit from its center. Its squared distance is 1. Four such points contribute 4.
answer.zh: 每个点与中心的竖直距离为一，平方距离为 1。四个点合计为 4。

question.en: What does retaining 80% variance mean?
question.zh: 保留 80% 方差意味着什么？

answer.en: Horizontal variance is 4 and vertical variance is 1. Keeping the horizontal direction retains 4/(4+1). It does not mean 80% classification accuracy.
answer.zh: 水平方差为 4，竖直方差为 1。保留水平方向得到 4/(4+1)。这不代表分类准确率为 80%。

question.en: Why might a small-variance direction still matter?
question.zh: 方差小的方向为什么仍可能重要？

answer.en: A rare but useful difference can have little overall spread. PCA has no labels telling it that this difference matters for a later task.
answer.zh: 少见但有用的差别，整体离散程度可能很小。PCA 没有标签来告诉它这个差别对后续任务重要。

body.en: Multiply the vertical coordinate in the example by three. Vertical variance becomes 9 while horizontal variance stays 4. The first PCA direction changes, showing why units matter.
body.zh: 把示例中的竖直坐标乘三。竖直方差变为 9，水平方差仍为 4。第一主成分方向改变，说明单位的重要性。

body.en: Cluster invented clip features such as duration and energy. Listen to representative clips before naming groups. A group of loud clips may reflect recording gain rather than sound type.
body.zh: 对时长、能量等自拟片段特征聚类。命名之前听取代表片段。一组大音量片段可能只是录音增益相近，不一定属于同一声音类型。

title.zh: 计算分组与 PCA 方差

intro.en: A rectangle makes both calculations visible.
intro.zh: 矩形数据让两种计算都容易看清。

code_examples.code:
import numpy as np
x = np.array([[0., 0.], [0., 2.], [4., 0.], [4., 2.]])
centers = np.array([[0., 1.], [4., 1.]])
assignment = np.array([0, 0, 1, 1])
loss = np.sum((x - centers[assignment]) ** 2)
centered = x - x.mean(axis=0)
covariance = centered.T @ centered / len(x)
values = np.linalg.eigvalsh(covariance)
print(f'cluster loss: {loss:.1f}')
print('covariance:', covariance.tolist())
print(f'first variance share: {values[-1] / values.sum():.2f}')
code_examples.output:
cluster loss: 4.0
covariance: [[4.0, 0.0], [0.0, 1.0]]
first variance share: 0.80

explanation.en: centers[assignment] selects one center per row. Squaring and summing yields the grouping loss. mean(axis=0) computes each column mean. .T swaps axes; @ multiplies matrices to form population covariance. eigvalsh returns its eigenvalues in ascending order, so the final one is largest. This code measures chosen groups and variance. It does not discover rock types or run an iterative k-means fit.
explanation.zh: centers[assignment] 为每行选一个中心。平方再求和得到分组损失。mean(axis=0) 计算每列均值。.T 交换轴，@ 矩阵乘法构建总体协方差。eigvalsh 按升序返回特征值，因此最后一个最大。代码衡量已选分组和方差，没有发现岩石类别，也没有运行迭代 K-means 拟合。

title.en: Recommendation: rank items by a stated similarity
title.zh: 推荐：按明确的相似度排序

story.en:
Rui wants to suggest library videos to a science club. Each video has two hand-labeled features: astronomy and robotics. She represents one viewer’s stated interests with the same two features. A dot product gives each video a score.

Rui notices that a video with many tags can score highly just because its vector is longer. She compares cosine similarity, which removes vector length from the comparison. The ranking now reflects direction in the feature space. She shows why each video was suggested and invites feedback. This is a transparent content-based recommender, but it cannot discover interests that its two features never describe.
story.zh:
芮想为科学社推荐图书馆视频。每个视频有两个手工特征：天文与机器人。她用相同两维表示观众主动表达的兴趣，再用点积给视频评分。

芮发现标签很多的视频可能只因向量更长而得高分，于是比较去除长度影响的余弦相似度。排序现在体现特征空间的方向。她展示推荐原因并收集反馈。这是透明的内容推荐，但无法发现这两个特征从未描述的兴趣。

concept.en:
A content-based recommender compares item features with a user profile in the same space. A dot product multiplies matching coordinates and adds them. Cosine similarity divides that product by both vector lengths. It measures alignment rather than size.

Ranking sorts candidate items by score. A candidate set is the list considered before ranking. Remove unavailable or already-seen items when the task calls for it. A similarity score is not a probability of enjoyment. Evaluate relevance and variety with a clear feedback protocol.
concept.zh:
基于内容的推荐器在相同空间中比较物品特征与用户画像。点积把对应坐标相乘后相加。余弦相似度再除以两个向量长度，衡量方向一致程度，而非大小。

排序按分数排列候选物品。候选集是排序前考虑的列表。任务需要时，移除不可用或已看过内容。相似分数不是喜欢的概率。应按明确反馈流程评估相关性与多样性。

application.en: Use this idea for related reading, video suggestions, or similar document search. Start with understandable tags, then compare richer learned features. Keep a fallback for a new viewer with no profile and for items with no tags.
application.zh: 可用于相关阅读、视频建议或相似文档搜索。先用容易理解的标签，再比较更丰富的学习特征。为无画像的新观众与无标签物品准备后备规则。

practice.en: Google’s recommendation course documents content-based filtering and dot-product similarity. Our tagged-video example adds an explicit cosine calculation for inspection. It claims no production ranking quality.
practice.zh: Google 推荐课程介绍基于内容的过滤与点积相似度。这里的标签视频示例加入明确的余弦计算，便于检查，不声称具有生产推荐质量。

symbols.en: u is the interest vector and v is an item vector. j indexes matching feature positions. · is the dot product. ‖u‖ is Euclidean vector length. √ means square root and Σ means sum. Both lengths must be nonzero for cosine similarity.
symbols.zh: u 是兴趣向量，v 是物品向量，j 表示对应特征位置。· 是点积，‖u‖ 是欧氏向量长度。√ 表示平方根，Σ 表示求和。计算余弦相似度时，两个长度都必须非零。

calculation.en: Let the profile be [1,1]. Astronomy [1,0] and robotics [0,1] each score 1/√2≈0.707. A mixed video [1,1] scores 2/(√2×√2)=1. Scaling that video to [2,2] leaves its cosine at 1. In contrast, its dot product rises from 2 to 4.

limits.en: A zero vector has no cosine direction. Narrow profiles can repeat very similar items. Hand labels can be incomplete. Similarity alone does not measure quality, novelty, or whether the viewer actually liked the item.
limits.zh: 零向量没有可定义的余弦方向。狭窄画像可能重复推荐相似物品。手工标签可能不完整。相似度本身不能衡量质量、新颖性或观众是否真的喜欢。

takeaway.en: Choose a representation and score that match the recommendation question, then test the ranking with feedback.
takeaway.zh: 选择符合推荐问题的表示与分数，再用反馈检验排序。

meaning.en: A feature vector describing stated or inferred interests.
meaning.zh: 描述主动表达或推断兴趣的特征向量。

meaning.en: The dot product divided by both lengths, measuring directional alignment.
meaning.zh: 点积除以双方长度，用于衡量方向一致程度。

meaning.en: Items considered before ranking chooses their order.
meaning.zh: 排序决定顺序之前考虑的物品集合。

question.en: Why do both one-topic videos score 0.707?
question.zh: 为什么两个单主题视频都得 0.707？

answer.en: The profile weights both topics equally. Each dot product is one, and the lengths are √2 and one.
answer.zh: 画像对两个主题权重相同。点积都是一，长度分别为 √2 与一。

question.en: Does score 1 mean certain enjoyment?
question.zh: 分数为 1 是否表示肯定喜欢？

answer.en: No. It means the represented directions match. The chosen features may omit pacing, difficulty, or the viewer’s current needs.
answer.zh: 不是。它只表示当前表示的方向相同。特征可能遗漏节奏、难度或观众当前需求。

question.en: What if the profile is [0,0]?
question.zh: 画像为 [0,0] 时怎么办？

answer.en: Division by its zero length is undefined. Ask for interests or use a clearly labeled general fallback instead of fabricating a similarity.
answer.zh: 除以零长度未定义。可以收集兴趣，或使用明确标注的通用后备规则，不要编造相似度。

body.en: Give three invented articles two topic tags. Rank them for profile [1,0]. Compare the result with profile [0,1]. Explain the changed order from the coordinates.
body.zh: 给三篇自拟文章标两个主题特征。对画像 [1,0] 排序，再与 [0,1] 比较，用坐标解释顺序变化。

body.en: Double every coordinate of one item. Its dot product doubles but its cosine stays fixed. Decide whether magnitude contains useful evidence in your particular recommendation task.
body.zh: 把一个物品所有坐标乘二。点积加倍，但余弦不变。判断在你的推荐任务中，向量大小是否包含有用证据。

intro.en: The tags are hand chosen; this example learns no embeddings.
intro.zh: 标签为手工设定；示例不学习嵌入。

code_examples.code:
import numpy as np
names = ['astronomy', 'robotics', 'mixed']
items = np.array([[1.,0.], [0.,1.], [1.,1.]])
profile = np.array([1.,1.])
scores = (items @ profile) / (np.linalg.norm(items, axis=1) * np.linalg.norm(profile))
order = np.argsort(-scores, kind='stable')
for index in order:
    print(f'{names[index]}: {scores[index]:.3f}')

explanation.en: @ forms one dot product per item. norm computes vector length; axis=1 keeps item lengths separate. Division removes length effects. Sorting negative scores puts larger values first, with input order resolving ties. The mixed item ranks first under these tags. This is an inspectable scoring rule, not a validated viewer-preference model.
explanation.zh: @ 为每个物品计算点积。norm 计算向量长度，axis=1 分别保留物品长度。除法去掉长度影响。对负分排序使高分在前，平局按输入顺序处理。在这些标签下混合视频排第一。这是可检查的评分规则，不是经验证的观众偏好模型。

title.en: Validate choices and prepare for a changing setting
title.zh: 验证模型选择，为场景变化做好准备

story.en:
Ren predicts greenhouse humidity from several sensor readings. A flexible model almost matches the first month perfectly. It does poorly on later days. Ren tries a penalty that discourages large weights. He compares strengths on time-ordered validation periods. The best training fit no longer wins.

He tests the chosen model once on an untouched final period. Later, new ventilation equipment changes the greenhouse. Ren does not treat the old score as a permanent promise. He collects fresh labels and checks performance again. Validation helped choose a model for one setting. Monitoring must show whether that setting still describes the world.
story.zh:
任用多个传感器读数预测温室湿度。灵活模型几乎完全拟合第一个月，却在后来的日期表现很差。他尝试惩罚大权重，并按时间顺序的验证时段比较不同强度。训练拟合最好的模型不再胜出。

他在未使用的最终时段上测试所选模型。后来通风设备更换，温室情况发生变化。任没有把旧分数当作永久承诺，而是收集新标签再次检查性能。验证帮助他为某种环境选模型，监测还要确认现实是否仍符合这种环境。

concept.en:
Overfitting means learning details that help the training data but fail to transfer. L2 regularization adds the squared weights to the training objective, multiplied by a chosen strength. This discourages very large coefficients. It may improve generalization, but that is a question for validation.

Cross-validation repeats fitting and evaluation on several splits called folds. All learned preprocessing belongs inside each fold. Time and group dependencies still matter. Distribution shift means the future data or input-target relationship changes. Regularization does not protect against every such change.
concept.zh:
过拟合是学到只帮助训练数据、却无法迁移的细节。L2 正则化把权重平方和乘以指定强度，再加到训练目标中，从而抑制过大系数。它可能改善泛化，但需要验证来判断。

交叉验证在称为“折”的多个划分上重复拟合与评估。所有需要学习的预处理都应在每个折内部完成。时间与分组依赖仍要考虑。分布变化指未来数据或输入与目标的关系改变。正则化无法防御所有这类变化。

application.en: Define a modest set of candidate settings and compare them on the same validation folds. Place every learned preprocessing step inside each fold. Use group or chronological splits when the task requires them, and keep a final evaluation period untouched by selection. Record input ranges, class proportions when relevant, and error patterns. After deployment changes, obtain fresh labeled evidence rather than treating input monitoring alone as a performance measurement.
application.zh: 定义数量适中的候选设置，并在相同验证折上比较。把所有需要学习的预处理步骤放到每个折内部。任务需要时，使用分组或按时间划分，并保留最终评估时间段，不让它参与选择。记录输入范围、适用时的类别比例，以及误差模式。部署条件改变后，应获取新的带标签证据，不要把只监测输入当成性能测量。

practice.en: The linked scikit-learn cross-validation guide documents group-aware and time-ordered splitters. Its linear-model guide presents ridge regression and validation of regularization strength. The linked Google dataset guide also discusses mismatches between evaluation data and later use. These sources support the workflow, while the greenhouse narrative is original. Note that the averaged-loss objective below uses a different penalty normalization from scikit-learn Ridge's summed-loss convention. With otherwise matching conventions, the Ridge penalty parameter equals the training sample count times λ.
practice.zh: 所链接的 scikit-learn 交叉验证指南说明了考虑分组和时间顺序的划分器。其线性模型指南介绍岭回归，以及正则化强度的验证。所链接的 Google 数据集指南也讨论了评估数据与后续使用场景不匹配的问题。这些资料支持了所述流程，温室叙事则为原创。请注意，下方平均损失目标的惩罚归一化方式，与 scikit-learn Ridge 所采用的求和损失约定不同。 在其他约定一致的情况下，Ridge 的惩罚参数等于训练样本数量乘以 λ。

topics.formula:
L_λ(w,b) = (1 / n) Σᵢ₌₁ⁿ (b + wᵀxᵢ − yᵢ)² + λ Σⱼ₌₁ᵈ wⱼ²
CV(λ) = (1 / K) Σₖ₌₁ᴷ MSEₖ(λ)

symbols.en: n is the training sample count; i indexes observations and j indexes d features. xᵢ is an input vector, yᵢ its target, w the coefficient vector, and b the unpenalized intercept. Superscript T denotes transpose, so wᵀxᵢ is a dot product. λ is a nonnegative penalty strength and L_λ the penalized training objective. Σ denotes summation. K is the number of validation folds and k selects one. MSEₖ is unpenalized error on fold k after fitting its corresponding training portion. CV is their unweighted mean; unequal fold sizes would require weights for a pooled per-example mean.
symbols.zh: n 是训练样本数；i 是观测下标，j 是 d 个特征中的特征下标。xᵢ 是输入向量，yᵢ 是目标，w 是系数向量，b 是不受惩罚的截距。上标 T 表示转置，因此 wᵀxᵢ 是点积。λ 是非负惩罚强度，L_λ 是带惩罚的训练目标。Σ 表示求和。K 是验证折的数量，k 指定其中一折。MSEₖ 是使用该折对应的训练部分拟合后，在该验证折上得到的不含惩罚项的误差。CV 是这些误差的未加权平均值；折大小不同时，若要得到按样本汇总的均值，需要加权。

calculation.en: Compare two synthetic coefficient vectors under the stated averaged-loss convention. Candidate A has training MSE 1.0 and squared coefficient sum 9; candidate B has training MSE 1.4 and squared coefficient sum 1. At λ = 0.1, their penalized objectives are 1.9 and 1.5, so B has the smaller objective despite worse raw training fit. This comparison illustrates the penalty and does not assert either vector is the optimized solution. Separately, suppose a validation search gives three equal-sized fold errors of 1.0, 1.4, and 1.2 for λ = 0, versus 0.9, 1.0, and 1.1 for λ = 0.1. Their means are 1.2 and 1.0. Choose the latter setting by validation, refit on development data, and evaluate once on the reserved final period.
calculation.zh: 在这里明确采用的平均损失约定下，比较两个合成系数向量。候选 A 的训练 MSE 为 1.0，系数平方和为 9；候选 B 的训练 MSE 为 1.4，系数平方和为 1。当 λ = 0.1 时，带惩罚的目标分别为 1.9 和 1.5，因此 B 虽然原始训练拟合较差，目标值却更小。这个比较只是说明惩罚项的作用，并未声称任一向量是优化后的解。另一个独立验证示例中，假设 λ = 0 在三个等大折上的误差为 1.0、1.4、1.2，而 λ = 0.1 时为 0.9、1.0、1.1。两者均值分别为 1.2 和 1.0。根据验证选择后一个设置，在开发数据上重新拟合，然后在保留的最终时间段上评估一次。

limits.en: Repeatedly searching many settings can overfit validation data. Cross-validation is not automatically valid for dependent observations or future forecasting. Regularization depends on feature scale and cannot supply missing information. Detecting a change in inputs does not prove accuracy fell, while stable input summaries do not guarantee that the target relationship remained stable.
limits.zh: 反复搜索大量设置可能使验证数据也发生过拟合。对于相互依赖的观测或未来预测，交叉验证并非自动有效。正则化依赖特征尺度，也无法提供缺失信息。发现输入变化并不能证明准确性下降；输入汇总统计稳定，也不能保证与目标的关系保持稳定。

takeaway.en: Use validation to choose complexity, reserve testing for the completed choice, and gather fresh evidence whenever the intended prediction setting changes.
takeaway.zh: 用验证选择复杂度，用保留测试评估已经完成的选择；只要预期预测场景改变，就收集新的证据。

meaning.en: Learning training-specific details that do not help new examples.
meaning.zh: 学到只适用于训练数据、不能帮助新样本的细节。

meaning.en: A constraint or penalty that changes which fitted solutions are preferred.
meaning.zh: 通过约束或惩罚改变对拟合解的偏好。

meaning.en: One training/evaluation partition used during cross-validation.
meaning.zh: 交叉验证中一次训练与评估的划分。

question.en: Why can worse training MSE give a smaller objective?
question.zh: 为什么训练 MSE 更差，目标值反而更小？

answer.en: Candidate B trades 0.4 more MSE for 0.8 less penalty. Its total is 1.4+0.1×1=1.5, below A’s 1.9.
answer.zh: 候选 B 的 MSE 增加 0.4，但惩罚减少 0.8。总值为 1.4+0.1×1=1.5，低于 A 的 1.9。

question.en: Which numbers should choose the penalty strength?
question.zh: 应该用哪些数值选择惩罚强度？

answer.en: Use validation errors, here fold means 1.2 and 1.0. The training objective helps fit weights; it is not an independent measure of future error.
answer.zh: 使用验证误差，这里折均值为 1.2 与 1.0。训练目标用于拟合权重，不是未来误差的独立度量。

question.en: Do unchanged input averages prove the model is still accurate?
question.zh: 输入均值不变是否证明模型仍准确？

answer.en: No. The relationship between inputs and labels may change while averages stay similar. Obtain fresh labeled cases to measure errors.
answer.zh: 不证明。即使均值相近，输入与标签的关系也可能改变。需要新的带标签样本来测量误差。

body.en: Compare the two validation-error lists in the code. Choose the lower mean before opening the test set. Refit the chosen setting on development data, then report one final test result.
body.zh: 比较代码中两组验证误差。在查看测试集之前选择均值较低者。用开发数据重新拟合所选设置，再报告一次最终测试结果。

body.en: A sound classifier moves from a quiet room to a hall. Keep a recent labeled sample from the hall. Compare error types, not only average volume, before deciding whether adaptation helps.
body.zh: 声音分类器从安静房间移到大厅。保留大厅近期的带标签样本。在判断适应训练是否有帮助前，比较错误类型，而不只是平均音量。

intro.en: Candidate summaries illustrate two different comparisons.
intro.zh: 用候选摘要演示两种不同的比较。

code_examples.output:
A objective: 1.9
B objective: 1.5
lambda 0.0: validation MSE 1.2
lambda 0.1: validation MSE 1.0
chosen lambda: 0.1

explanation.en: Each candidate stores its training MSE and squared-weight sum. The first loop adds the penalty. The folds dictionary stores independent illustrative validation summaries. The next calculation averages equal-sized folds. min with key=means.get selects the strength with the smallest validation error. It does not select by penalized training loss. These are supplied summaries, not results from a fitted model.
explanation.zh: 每个候选保存训练 MSE 与权重平方和。第一个循环加上惩罚。folds 字典存放另一组示意性的验证摘要。接着对等大小折取平均。min 的 key=means.get 选择验证误差最小的强度，不按惩罚后的训练损失选择。这些是预设摘要，不是实际拟合模型的结果。

title.en: Check confidence and watch for change
title.zh: 检查置信程度并监测变化

story.en:
Ari’s spam filter marks many messages with probability 0.8. She initially reads that as an 80% success guarantee for each message. Instead, she groups recent labeled messages with similar probabilities. Among four messages predicted near 0.8, only two are spam. The model is too confident in this small group.

Ari records the group size and repeats the check with more data. She also tracks missing inputs and new vocabulary. These checks answer different questions. Input changes warn that conditions may have changed. Fresh labels reveal whether predictions remain useful. She plans recalibration on separate data rather than rewriting probabilities from the final test set.
story.zh:
阿丽的垃圾消息过滤器常给出 0.8 概率。她起初把它理解成每条消息都有 80% 的成功保证。后来她把近期带标签、概率相近的消息分组。四条预测约为 0.8 的消息中，只有两条是垃圾消息。在这个小组里模型过于自信。

阿丽记录组大小，并收集更多数据重复检查。她还监测缺失输入和新词。它们回答不同问题：输入变化提示条件可能改变，新标签揭示预测是否仍有用。她计划用独立数据重新校准，而不是从最终测试集改写概率。

concept.en:
Calibration asks whether estimated probabilities agree with observed frequencies over comparable cases. A reliability bin groups nearby estimates. Compare the bin’s mean probability with its positive-label fraction. Small bins are noisy, so keep their counts.

The Brier score averages squared differences between probability and a zero-or-one label. Lower is better for that score, but it combines several aspects of prediction quality; it is not a pure calibration measure. Monitoring also checks input validity, missingness, and labeled error rates over time. Recalibration needs data separate from the final evaluation.
concept.zh:
校准检查相似案例中，估计概率是否与观测频率一致。可靠性分箱把相近估计分组，比较组内平均概率与正类比例。小组噪声较大，应保留计数。

布里尔分数平均概率与零或一标签之差的平方。该指标越低越好，但它结合预测质量的多个方面，并非纯校准指标。监测还检查输入有效性、缺失率与随时间变化的带标签错误率。重新校准需要与最终评估分离的数据。

application.en: A spam review queue needs both useful ranking and interpretable confidence. Track probability bins on recent labeled messages. Also track new categories and missing features. Investigate changes, then compare any updated model on an independent period.
application.zh: 垃圾消息复核队列既需要有效排序，也需要可解释的置信程度。用近期带标签消息检查概率分箱，同时监测新类别与缺失特征。调查变化后，再在独立时段比较更新模型。

practice.en: The official calibration guide explains reliability diagrams and proper scoring rules. Google’s monitoring guide describes data checks and live labeled quality checks. The example is a tiny diagnostic, not a sufficient sample for deciding a recalibration policy.
practice.zh: 官方校准指南解释可靠性图与恰当评分规则。Google 监测指南介绍数据检查与上线后的带标签质量检查。本例只是微型诊断，样本不足以决定重新校准策略。

topics.formula:
p̄_b = (1/n_b) Σᵢ∈b pᵢ
f_b = (1/n_b) Σᵢ∈b yᵢ
Brier = (1/n) Σᵢ₌₁ⁿ (pᵢ−yᵢ)²

symbols.en: b is a nonempty probability bin and n_b is its count. pᵢ is a predicted positive probability and yᵢ is its zero-or-one label. p̄_b is the mean predicted probability; f_b is the observed positive fraction. n counts all evaluated examples. Σ adds entries.
symbols.zh: b 是非空概率分箱，n_b 是箱内数量。pᵢ 是预测正类概率，yᵢ 是零或一标签。p̄_b 为平均预测概率，f_b 为观测正类比例。n 是全部评估样本数，Σ 表示相加。

calculation.en: Use probabilities [0.8,0.8,0.8,0.8] and labels [1,1,0,0]. The mean prediction is 0.8, but the positive fraction is 2/4=0.5. Squared errors are [0.04,0.04,0.64,0.64]. Their average is 1.36/4=0.34. Four cases suggest a question; they do not establish a precise population calibration error.

limits.en: Delayed or missing labels limit monitoring. Binning choices change the display. Calibration may deteriorate after distribution shift. A changed feature mean is a warning, not proof that prediction error increased.
limits.zh: 标签延迟或缺失限制监测。分箱方式会改变图示。分布变化后校准可能退化。特征均值改变只是警讯，不证明预测误差增加。

takeaway.en: Confidence needs frequency checks. Model quality needs fresh labels, especially when inputs or conditions change.
takeaway.zh: 置信程度需要频率检查。模型质量需要新标签，尤其是在输入或环境变化时。

meaning.en: Agreement between predicted probabilities and observed frequencies over comparable cases.
meaning.zh: 相似案例中预测概率与观测频率的一致程度。

meaning.en: A group of examples with similar predicted probabilities.
meaning.zh: 预测概率相近的一组样本。

meaning.en: The mean squared difference between predicted probability and binary outcome.
meaning.zh: 预测概率与二元结果之差的平方均值。

question.en: Does 0.8 mean a particular message is partly spam?
question.zh: 0.8 是否表示一条消息有部分是垃圾消息？

answer.en: No. The label is still zero or one. Probability describes uncertainty. Calibration concerns frequencies across many comparable messages.
answer.zh: 不是。标签仍为零或一。概率描述不确定性，校准针对许多相似消息的频率。

question.en: Why do negative labels contribute 0.64 here?
question.zh: 这里负标签为何贡献 0.64？

answer.en: For y=0, the difference is 0.8−0=0.8. Squaring gives 0.64. Confident incorrect probabilities are penalized strongly.
answer.zh: y=0 时差为 0.8−0=0.8，平方为 0.64。自信但错误的概率受到较大惩罚。

question.en: Can monitoring without labels certify accuracy?
question.zh: 没有标签的监测能证明准确率吗？

answer.en: No. It can detect schema or input changes. Measuring correctness requires trustworthy outcomes or labels.
answer.zh: 不能。它能发现格式或输入变化，但衡量正确性需要可靠结果或标签。

body.en: Replace all four probabilities with 0.5. The Brier score becomes 0.25 on these labels. This improves this small score; validate any learned recalibration on separate data.
body.zh: 把四个概率都改为 0.5，此组标签上的布里尔分数变成 0.25。这个小样本分数改善了；任何学到的重新校准仍需独立数据验证。

body.en: Track missing-feature rates before and after a document importer changes. If the rate rises, inspect parsing first. Collect fresh labels before attributing the change to lower classifier accuracy.
body.zh: 文档导入器改变前后监测特征缺失率。若升高，先检查解析。判断分类准确率是否下降前，收集新标签。

intro.en: All four examples belong to one bin near probability 0.8.
intro.zh: 四个例子都属于概率约为 0.8 的同一分箱。

code_examples.code:
import numpy as np
probability = np.array([0.8,0.8,0.8,0.8])
label = np.array([1.,1.,0.,0.])
brier = np.mean((probability - label) ** 2)
print('bin count:', len(label))
print(f'mean probability: {probability.mean():.2f}')
print(f'observed positive fraction: {label.mean():.2f}')
print(f'Brier score: {brier:.2f}')
code_examples.output:
bin count: 4
mean probability: 0.80
observed positive fraction: 0.50
Brier score: 0.34

explanation.en: The arrays pair each probability with its true label. Subtraction, squaring, and mean implement the Brier score. The label mean is the positive fraction because labels are zero or one. The printed count reminds us how little evidence four cases provide. The script diagnoses supplied predictions; it does not fit a calibrator or monitor a live system.
explanation.zh: 数组把每个概率与真实标签配对。相减、平方、取平均实现布里尔分数。标签为零或一，因此均值就是正类比例。打印数量提醒我们四个案例的证据有限。脚本诊断预设预测，没有拟合校准器，也没有监控真实系统。

title.zh: 数据集：划分原始数据集

title.en: Logistic regression: Calculating a probability with the sigmoid function
title.zh: 逻辑回归：使用 sigmoid 函数计算概率

title.en: Classification: Accuracy, recall, precision, and related metrics
title.zh: 分类：准确率、召回率、精确率与相关指标

title.en: Ensembles: Gradient boosting, random forests, bagging, voting, stacking
title.zh: 集成：梯度提升、随机森林、装袋、投票与堆叠

title.en: Decomposing signals in components: Principal component analysis
title.zh: 把信号分解为成分：主成分分析
交叉验证：评估估计器性能

title.en: Linear Models: Ridge regression and classification
title.zh: 线性模型：岭回归与分类
虚拟估计器与基线比较
交叉验证：评估估计器性能

title.en: Tuning the decision threshold for class prediction
Start with rows, features, labels, and a baseline
title.zh: 从行、特征、标签与基线开始

body.en: Define the example and answer first. Then keep a simple comparison that every complex model must improve.
body.zh: 先定义样本与答案，再保留一个简单比较，让复杂模型证明改进。

title.en: Define the question before dividing the data
title.zh: 划分数据之前，先定义问题

body.en: A score becomes meaningful only after you specify what is predicted, when information becomes available, and what kind of unseen case the split represents.
body.zh: 只有明确预测什么、信息何时可用，以及划分代表哪一种未见案例之后，分数才有意义。

title.en: Inspect the table before filling gaps
title.zh: 填补缺口前先检查表格

body.en: First learn what a blank means. Then fill it using training information and preserve the missingness record.
body.zh: 先弄清空白的含义，再用训练信息填补，并保留缺失记录。

body.en: Encoding should express category meaning, keep column order fixed, and state how unseen values are handled.
body.zh: 编码要表达类别含义，固定列顺序，并明确处理未见值。

title.en: Linear regression: predict a number with a line
title.zh: 线性回归：用直线预测数值

body.en: Linear regression is a transparent baseline; its loss defines which mistakes matter, and its residuals reveal what the line leaves unexplained.
body.zh: 线性回归是透明的基线；损失函数决定哪些错误更重要，残差则揭示直线尚未解释的部分。

title.en: Learn with controlled steps and comparable scales
title.zh: 用可控步长和可比尺度学习

body.en: Inspect the update rule, input units, and loss curve together; stable optimization is necessary for learning, but it is not evidence of generalization.
body.zh: 把更新规则、输入单位和损失曲线放在一起检查；稳定优化是学习的必要条件，却不是泛化能力的证据。

body.en: Train the probability model and choose the decision threshold as related but separate steps, then evaluate the complete rule on untouched data.
body.zh: 把训练概率模型与选择决策阈值视为相关但独立的步骤，再用未参与选择的数据评估完整规则。

title.en: Count the mistakes that the task actually cares about
title.zh: 统计任务真正关心的错误

body.en: Keep the confusion matrix close to every headline score; the right metric must reveal the errors that matter for the intended use.
body.zh: 让混淆矩阵始终伴随主要分数；合适的指标必须揭示预期用途真正关心的错误。

title.en: Nearest neighbours: borrow evidence from nearby examples
title.zh: 近邻法：向附近样本借用证据

body.en: A neighbour prediction is only as sensible as its distance, feature scales, and stored examples.
body.zh: 近邻预测是否合理，取决于距离、特征尺度与保存的样本。

title.en: Naive Bayes: classify short texts from word counts
title.zh: 朴素贝叶斯：用词频分类短文本

body.en: Count words, smooth the counts, combine evidence, and inspect where context breaks the simple assumption.
body.zh: 统计词频、平滑计数、结合证据，再检查语境在哪些地方打破简单假设。

title.en: Build rules, then understand what combining them changes
title.zh: 建立规则，再理解组合规则会改变什么

body.en: Trees turn interactions into explicit regions; ensembles can stabilize predictions, but every added layer of complexity still needs validation on the intended task.
body.zh: 树模型把交互作用转化为明确区域；集成方法可以稳定预测，但每增加一层复杂度，都仍需针对预期任务进行验证。

title.zh: 提升法：学习下一次修正

body.en: Boosting asks the next learner to repair what the current prediction still misses.
body.zh: 提升法让下一个模型修复当前预测仍遗漏的部分。

title.zh: 寻找结构，不凭空赋予标签

body.en: Use clustering to propose groups and PCA to compress variation, then test your interpretation with evidence that neither method supplied.
body.zh: 用聚类提出分组，用 PCA 压缩变化，再用这两种方法本身没有提供的证据检验解释。

title.en: Recommendation: rank items by a stated similarity
title.zh: 推荐：按明确的相似度排序

body.en: Choose a representation and score that match the recommendation question, then test the ranking with feedback.
body.zh: 选择符合推荐问题的表示与分数，再用反馈检验排序。

title.en: Validate choices and prepare for a changing setting
title.zh: 验证模型选择，为场景变化做好准备

body.en: Use validation to choose complexity, reserve testing for the completed choice, and gather fresh evidence whenever the intended prediction setting changes.
body.zh: 用验证选择复杂度，用保留测试评估已经完成的选择；只要预期预测场景改变，就收集新的证据。

title.en: Check confidence and watch for change
title.zh: 检查置信程度并监测变化

body.en: Confidence needs frequency checks. Model quality needs fresh labels, especially when inputs or conditions change.
body.zh: 置信程度需要频率检查。模型质量需要新标签，尤其是在输入或环境变化时。
